system.name: GRANNY
system.one_liner: a runtime for granular management of compute-intensive cloud applications that cross-compiles code to WebAssembly and virtualizes OpenMP/MPI/POSIX backends

components.name: VM A
components.role: the machine hosting Granule 0 throughout; gains a migrated Granule 1 in panel (c)

components.name: VM B
components.role: the machine hosting Granule 1 in panels (a)/(b) before it is migrated away in panel (c)

components.name: Granule 0
components.role: the application's main Granule (MPI rank 0), running on VM A, which queries the scheduler at barrier control points

components.name: Granule 1
components.role: a second Granule (MPI rank 1), initially on VM B, migrated to VM A in panel (c)

components.name: MPI backend
components.role: captures MPI_Send/MPI_Recv/MPI_Barrier calls, tracks each Granule's rank mapping, and exchanges BARRIER_JOIN/BARRIER_DONE messages

components.name: POSIX backend
components.role: captures file operations (e.g., fwrite) and maps WebAssembly file descriptors to OS file descriptors

components.name: Scheduler
components.role: queried at each barrier control point ('Must migrate?') and returns a migration plan

components.name: Migration plan
components.role: output of the scheduler specifying which Granule moves where (e.g., G1: B to A)

components.name: Granny core
components.role: prepares and applies the migration: creates/terminates Granules, updates mailbox mappings, and restores snapshots

components.name: Granule 1 snapshot
components.role: captured linear memory and runtime state of Granule 1 (file mapping, bytes to fread) used to recreate it on VM A

content.key_idea: At a barrier control point, GRANNY safely migrates a Granule between VMs by snapshotting its state on the source and restoring it on the destination before resuming.
content.reading_order: left to right across three panels: (a) Normal execution message exchange, (b) both Granules reaching the Barrier control point and querying the Scheduler, (c) Granny core executing the Migration

summary: GRANNY manages cloud applications as 'Granules' that can be horizontally migrated between VMs at safe points. Figure 4 walks through one migration scenario in three panels. (a) Normal execution: Granule 0 on VM A sends an MPI message that its MPI backend copies into Granule 1's mailbox on VM B, which is delivered via a captured MPI_Recv; Granule 1 also performs a POSIX file write. (b) Barrier control point: both Granules reach MPI_Barrier and send BARRIER_JOIN to Granule 0, whose runtime queries the Scheduler ('Must migrate?'), which returns a Migration plan (G1: B to A). (c) Migration: the Granny core creates an empty Granule 1 on VM A while VM B snapshots and terminates the original, then VM A restores Granule 1 and broadcasts BARRIER_DONE so both resume. Circled numbers 1-12 trace the sequence.
summary_zh: 图4分(a)(b)(c)三面板展示GRANNY的Granule水平迁移全过程：正常收发消息、屏障点查询调度器获得迁移计划、Granny core创建/快照/恢复Granule并广播完成信号，编号1-12贯穿始终。
